hero.description:
Grupo PALENKKE is an international platform focused on brand development, commercial expansion and strategic positioning in national and international markets.

With more than 17 years of experience in international retail and commercial development, we connect products, producers and opportunities with real channels of growth and distribution.

Our vision combines tradition, strategy and global expansion to build solid projects with identity and international projection.

about.heading: Grupo PALENKKE
about.p1:
Grupo PALENKKE was born with the vision of connecting tradition and cultural identity as cultural heritage in an era of constant change, toward national and international global commercial expansion.

The name PALENKKE represents, on one hand, the value of traditional craftsmanship as cultural heritage, promoting products, knowledge and techniques that are part of the essence of our communities, while making use of new technologies; it develops not only a new framework of opportunities for the benefit of our community but also generates dynamics of constant progress.
about.p2:
Through our experience in national and international retail and market development, we have built commercial relationships focused on sustainable growth, strategic positioning and expansion into new markets.

Today, Grupo PALENKKE functions as a commercial platform oriented toward brand development, product commercialization and the building of national and international opportunities.

productos.meta_desc: Discover Mezcal Elixír del Alma: traditional craftsmanship, Mexican identity and international commercial expansion.
productos.hero_sub: Artisanal mezcal made in Mexico under traditional processes that respect the origin and quality of the agave.
productos.about_heading: The Story Behind Mezcal Elixír del Alma
productos.about_p1: The name Ixu Nahual is born from the fusion of Michoacán identity and the mysticism of the nahual: guardian of the spirit and tradition. For generations, mezcal-making families have perfected the art of transforming wild agave into a drink that connects the land with the soul.
productos.about_p2: Mezcal is more than a drink: it is a ritual that invites you to share moments, culture and roots. Among the most representative varieties we find Espadín, Cuishe, Tobalá, Cupreata, Papalote, among others, from which the essence that characterizes this ancestral drink is obtained. Its intense aroma and deep flavor reflect the land that saw it born and the hands that produced it.

elixir.hero_sub: Artisanal mezcal made in Mexico under traditional processes that respect the origin and quality of the agave.
elixir.variants_sub: Select the variant you want to know more details about

variants.name: Elixír del Alma Mezcal Joven
variants.subtitle: Artisanal Mezcal
variants.tasting: Notes of fresh agave, soft citrus and an elegant smoky finish.
variants.description: IXU Nahual Joven is the naked essence of the agave, a distillate that conveys the strength of the land and the freshness of the moment. Every sip is an ancestral chant, a reminder that greatness resides in purity.

variants.name: Elixír del Alma Mezcal Añejo
variants.subtitle: Aged Artisanal Mezcal
variants.tasting: Notes of vanilla, caramel, toasted wood and mature agave with a long finish.
variants.description: IXU Nahual añejo mezcal is a sophisticated expression, the result of an aging process in oak barrels for at least 12 months. This resting period adds complexity, smoothness and a unique aromatic profile, making it a distillate of elegant and deep character.

variants.name: Elixír del Alma Mezcal Rosé
variants.subtitle: Premium Artisanal Mezcal
variants.tasting: Floral notes, red berries, soft agave and a fresh, elegant finish.
variants.description: In every drop of IXU Nahual Rosé dwells the strength and sweetness of the feminine. It is a mezcal born from the Cupreata Silvestre agave of Michoacán, cooked in stone ovens and distilled in copper, receiving a delicate touch of red berries and rose petals, achieving a subtle pink tone that lights up the glass like an eternal sunset.

variants.name: Elixír del Alma Mezcal Coco Blend
variants.subtitle: Premium Artisanal Mezcal
variants.tasting: Floral notes, red berries, soft agave and a fresh, elegant finish.
variants.description: In the heart of Michoacán, where fire caresses the land and the wind dances with the agaves, a unique jewel is born: IXU Nahual Mezcal Joven - Coco Blend. This elixir is forged in stone ovens, where the pineapples of the Cupreata Silvestre agave are slowly cooked along with the magic of coconut, infusing every fiber with its tropical and ancestral essence.

elixir.process_intro: Making a good mezcal is an art that requires time, patience and experience. Our Master Mezcaleros follow a careful and traditional process:

process_steps.title: Cooking
process_steps.desc: The agave pineapples are cooked in stone ovens.

process_steps.title: Milling
process_steps.desc: They are crushed by hand to extract the juices.

process_steps.title: Fermentation
process_steps.desc: Nature is allowed to transform the must.

process_steps.title: Distillation
process_steps.desc: The mezcal takes shape in copper stills.

elixir.process_outro: Each master stamps his unique seal on every batch, achieving a perfect balance between flavor, aroma and character.
elixir.distribution_sub: Elixír del Alma Mezcal is available in key markets through specialized channels

distributors.channels: Specialized retail, premium restaurants, craft bars

legal.meta_desc: Partner with Grupo Palenkke: distribution alliances, retail collaborations, brand ambassadors and more.
legal.hero_sub:
We are open to exploring customized collaborations that align with the values and vision of our brand.

Whether co-branded products, promotional campaigns, strategic alliances or immersive commercial experiences, we work alongside our partners to turn ideas into real opportunities for mutual growth.

Our goal is to build solid, sustainable relationships focused on international expansion.

items.title: Distribution Alliances
items.desc:
Expand your portfolio with Grupo PALENKKE's exclusive resources and products.

Partner with us to distribute our premium products in international markets.

Benefit from our commitment to quality, authenticity and tradition, and together let's bring the legacy of our Mexican artisans to new markets and consumers around the world.

items.title: Retail Collaborations
items.desc:
Elevate your retail experience alongside Grupo PALENKKE.

Showcase our products in your commercial spaces and offer your customers the opportunity to discover the flavors, identity and essence of Mexico.

Collaborate with us to develop exclusive promotions, activations and unique commercial experiences that connect with your consumers.

items.title: Brand Ambassador Program
items.desc:
Join Grupo PALENKKE as a brand ambassador.

Share your passion for our products and become a key representative of our brand or even your own brand within our commercial ecosystem.

Enjoy exclusive benefits while helping expand the essence and experience of Grupo PALENKKE to new communities and markets.

items.title: Event Sponsorship
items.desc:
Connect your brand with the experience and presence of Grupo PALENKKE through exclusive sponsorships.

From festivals to private events and premium experiences, our products can elevate the guest experience and generate a memorable impact.

Explore personalized sponsorship opportunities designed to position your brand in dynamic, attractive and high commercial value environments.

items.title: Personalized Partnerships
items.desc:
Do you have a unique collaboration idea?

We are open to exploring personalized partnerships that align with the values and vision of Grupo PALENKKE.

Whether through co-branded products, promotional campaigns or immersive experiences, let's work together to transform ideas into new opportunities for mutual growth.

legal.cta_text: For more information about collaboration opportunities:
legal.asesoria_p1:
Legal advisory is fundamental for any growing business.

At Grupo PALENKKE we offer comprehensive legal accompaniment aimed at protecting and strengthening every commercial project.
legal.asesoria_p2:
From drafting and reviewing contracts to regulatory compliance, our team works to provide security, structure and confidence at every stage of commercial development.

Our approach allows each brand to operate with greater clarity, protection and strength within national and international markets.
